canonical_title: NorForge documents exposed Cairn agent panels used in widespread intrusions
treatment: Do not re-report without a verified post-publication hard delta.
known_facts: NorForge published its investigation on 2026-10-19, finding more than 20 exposed Cairn control panels likely associated with malicious activity.
NorForge documented an extensive Chinese-language cluster targeting e-commerce sites including in Japan, and observed live webshell evidence in at least one case.
Reuters independently reviewed activity and identified victims; Reuters reported over 1200 attempted sites and over 100 successful intrusions, while data exfiltration extent remained unverified.
Token cost estimates are rough and not audited.
reinclude_only_if: Independently verified additional victims or incident response
New reproducible agent security mitigation or material correction to attack counts
notes: Night delta: sources published on 2026-10-19 after 12:00 JST; 2026-10-19 midday run unavailable in repository; GitHub search returned no match.
